name: stage_1_stand_permissive_1min
description: Observation curriculum stage 1.  Permissive standing — full legacy reward density so brain bootstraps standing pose without competing pressures.  Auto-advance when best continuous stand reaches 60 sec (3600 ticks @ 60 Hz).  This is best_cumulative_alive_ticks which resets every fall, so the metric tracks the longest UNBROKEN upright span — not cumulative time across falls.

name: stage_2_walk_radial_to_3m
description: Observation curriculum stage 2.  Radial-outward walking reward + multiplicative gating (standing_baseline_factor=0.25, gated_walk_bonus_rate=0.20).  Auto-advance when max_distance_from_origin reaches 3m.  walk_target_velocity=0.15 so brain has gradient up to a reasonable body-speed cap.

name: stage_3_walk_over_there_terminal
description:
Observation curriculum stage 3 (terminal).  walk_over_there mode: random pyramid targets at visit_radius=0.5m, walk_target_velocity=0.1.  walk_reward_mode='to_target' projects chassis velocity onto chassis→target direction; approaching pays, receding misses.  On arrival within visit_radius the body fires a bonus hit and rotates to a new random pyramid.  Multiplicative gating stays on so brain keeps standing while pursuing targets.

This is a terminal stage — no advance_when, runs for the rest of the session.  Watch walk_visit_count in HUD to track number of pyramid visits.
